about.titlePart1: A Togolese NGO, a bridge with
about.text1: KommTogoGehWeiter Togo (KTGW Togo) is the Togolese branch of kommTOGOgehweiter e.V. (Cologne), passionately led by its President & Founder Mr. Blaise-Pascal D'ALMEIDA.
about.text2: Volunteers from Germany, France and Togo act together in Lomé, Aného, Kpalimé, Atakpamé, Kara and Dapaong to provide young people, especially young women, with high quality education.
about.quote: Every cent invested in education in Africa protects against dangerous journeys to Europe.
about.quoteAuthor: Motto shared by Mr. Blaise-Pascal D'ALMEIDA and kommTOGOgehweiter e.V.

objectives.title: The 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
objectives.subtitle: From poverty eradication to agricultural processing and modern industry, our programs champion the UN SDGs in Togo.

courses.title: Future-proof programs geared towards employment
courses.subtitle: Industrial mechatronics, food transformation, applied artisanal craftsmanship, applied mechanics, solar systems.
courses.mecatroniqueText: Automotive electronics, computerized diagnostics, programming, embedded systems and free German tuition. High school diploma (BAC) required.
courses.artisanatText: Metal shaping, fine woodwork, forge and manufacturing of applied practical equipment to meet local community and workshop needs.
courses.agroText: Solar fruit drying, grain processing, sanitary packaging and commercialization of high-value Togolese goods.
courses.mecaniqueText: Preventive maintenance, engine overhaul, electromechanics and industrial workshop safety standards.

projects.title: Tangible achievements on the ground
projects.subtitle: Each project responds directly to the needs of Togolese youth alongside our German and local partners.
